title.zh: 岗位与解题：协作比背答案重要
title.en: Roles and problem solving: collaboration matters more than memorized answers

subtitle.en: How process, equipment, PIE, yield and metrology work together

body.zh: Process：；Recipe与工艺窗口；•定义Recipe与参数范围；• 工艺窗口与风险评估；• 变更评估与DOE设计
body.en: Process: Recipe and process window • Define recipe and parameter ranges • Assess process window and risk • Assess changes and design DOE

body.zh: PIE：；Module Integration；与产品CTQ；• CTQ定义与失效机理分析；• 失效定位与结构表征；•与设计/封装协同闭环
body.en: PIE: Module integration and product CTQ • Define CTQ and analyze failure mechanisms • Localize failures and characterize structures • Close the loop with design / packaging

body.zh: Equipment：；Tool / Chamber/PM；• Tool状态与稳定性管理；•PM计划与执行；•异常隔离与维修验证
body.en: Equipment: Tool / chamber / PM • Manage tool condition and stability • Plan and execute PM • Contain anomalies and validate repairs

body.zh: Yield：；Defect / WAT/；Yield Correlation；• 缺陷监控与WAT分析；• Yield Correlation建模；• 风险预警与优先级排序
body.en: Yield: Defect / WAT / yield correlation • Monitor defects and analyze WAT • Model yield correlation • Warn of risks and prioritize

body.zh: Metrology：；量测能力与数据可信度；• 量测方法学与校准；•数据质量与不确定度；•量测趋势与异常确认
body.en: Metrology: Measurement capability and data credibility • Metrology methodology and calibration • Data quality and uncertainty • Confirm measurement trends and anomalies

body.zh: Evidence；Chain；Observations；Data & Logs；Samples；Analysis；Conclusion
body.en: Evidence chain Observations Data and logs Samples Analysis Conclusion

body.zh: 注：岗位名称与职责边界；会随公司与Fab组织方式变化，；协同目标是共同找出根因并；稳定量产。
body.en: Note: role names and responsibility boundaries vary with company and fab organization; the common goal is to find the root cause and stabilize production

body.zh: 六步解题流程；1；发现异常；SPC报警/趋势异常；超规/ 警报触发
body.en: Six-step problem-solving flow 1 Detect the anomaly SPC alarm / abnormal trend Specification breach / alarm trigger

body.zh: Containment；立即管控；Hold Lot / 限制流片；评估影响范围
body.en: Containment Immediate containment Hold lot / restrict processing Assess affected scope

body.zh: 收集日志与样品；RF/FDC；Logs；RF / FDC Logs；报警记录/事件时间线；样品（片/截面/颗粒）
body.en: Collect logs and samples RF / FDC Logs RF / FDC logs Alarm records / event timeline Samples (wafer / cross section / particles)

body.zh: 按Lot/Tool/；Chamber/时间分层；Lot；Tool；Chamber；Time；分层矩阵视图；定位异常集中区间；缩小搜索空间
body.en: Stratify by lot / tool / chamber / time Lot Tool Chamber Time Stratification matrix Locate the concentration of anomalies and narrow the search space

body.zh: Split实验或；维修验证；Repaired；Chamber；A/B Split实验；或维修后验证；对比结果
body.en: Split experiment or repair validation Repaired chamber A/B split experiment or post-repair validation Compare results

body.zh: 标准化与防复发；更新Control Plan；标准化作业与监控；防复发措施落地
body.en: Standardize and prevent recurrence Update the control plan Standardize operations and monitoring Implement recurrence-prevention actions

body.zh: 1 四类关键分层；Lot；Tool-Chamber；Recipe版本；Material-PM-Seasoning
body.en: 1 Four key stratifications Lot Tool–chamber Recipe version Material–PM–seasoning

body.zh: 2 核心Trade-off；快速恢复；产能；保留Root；Cause证据
body.en: 2 Core trade-off Rapid recovery of throughput Preserve root- cause evidence

body.zh: 改动变量越多，；归因能力越弱
body.en: The more variables change, the weaker causal attribution becomes

body.zh: 3 常见解题误区；相关性当因果；无Baseline；一次改多个参数；忽略PM状态；忽略量测误差
body.en: 3 Common troubleshooting mistakes Treating correlation as causation No baseline Changing multiple parameters at once Ignoring PM state Ignoring measurement error

body.zh: 4 证据可信度阶梯；现象；相关性；可重复Split；独立量测；机制闭环
body.en: 4 Evidence-credibility ladder Observation Correlation Repeatable split Independent measurement Mechanistic closure

body.zh: 量测反馈：SPC / FDC与Logs / Defect Map / XSEM/ WAT；SPC/趋势；FDC与Logs；Defect Map；XSEM / 分析；RF/ FDC Logs；报警/事件；WAT / 电性
body.en: Metrology feedback: SPC / FDC and logs / defect map / XSEM / WAT SPC / trends FDC and logs Defect map XSEM / analysis RF / FDC logs Alarms / events WAT / electrical properties

body.zh: Root Cause Hypothesis
body.en: Root-cause hypothesis

body.zh: 支持；验证并标准化
body.en: Supported Validate and standardize

body.zh: 不支持；更新假设
body.en: Not supported Update the hypothesis

body.zh: 影响：Cycle Time / Availability / Yield / Recurrence
body.en: Impact: cycle time / availability / yield / recurrence

body.zh: 岗位名称、职责边界与异常审批流程会随公司和Fab组织方式变化。
body.en: Role names, responsibility boundaries and abnormality approval procedures vary with company and fab organization

body.en: A
